topics.topic: DBRS Morningstar strategic direction and investment plans in credit ratings
topics.stated_position: Management said it is "confident in the increasing role DBRS Morningstar plays in the global markets," intends to "expand our corporate ratings footprint" and continue investing in global structured finance for traditional and non-traditional assets, framing these investments as "a stable path towards adjacent growth in the ratings delivery and fixed income data markets."
topics.quote: Overall, we are confident in the increasing role DBRS Morningstar plays in the global markets. We intend to expand our corporate ratings footprint and will continue to invest in the global structured finance markets related to both traditional and non-traditional assets. While beneficial in its own right, these investments also provide a stable path towards adjacent growth in the ratings delivery and fixed income data markets.

topics.topic: DBRS Morningstar plans to drive market share against the legacy rating agencies
topics.stated_position: In Canada management claims "market-leading positions" driven by "local expertise, existing market presence, and extensive track record"; beyond Canada it acknowledges "the three large legacy credit ratings agencies enjoy safeguards against new entrants," and targets "smaller, private, or transactional issues," European share gains as an "eligible credit rating agency," and the U.S. corporate middle market leveraging "our 45-year experience in assessing complex corporates, our more-granular pricing model, and our local expertise."
topics.quote: Beyond Canada, the three large legacy credit ratings agencies enjoy safeguards against new entrants in existing market segments, especially when bond issues are larger, public, and recurring. However, when the market seeks ratings on smaller, private, or transactional issues, all registered credit ratings agencies have the opportunity to compete. These are the focus areas where DBRS Morningstar has been highly successful to date in expanding its footprint and where we will continue to further accelerate our market presence.

topics.topic: Whether the SEC investigation will change the credit ratings business
topics.stated_position: Management stated it does not believe the SEC complaint against Morningstar's former credit ratings organization will cause any material disruptions or changes to current credit ratings strategy or operations.
topics.quote: At this time, we do not believe the SEC complaint against Morningstar’s former credit ratings organization will cause any material disruptions or changes to our current credit ratings strategy or operations.

topics.stated_position: Growth comes from three main drivers — growing the core customer base, "adjacent" customer segments, and product innovation/upgrades; in 2020 "over half of PitchBook's growth was driven from new sales," and the proportion from existing clients "should increase over time."
topics.quote: In 2020, over half of PitchBook’s growth was driven from new sales. As the existing client base grows and we continue to see strong net renewal rates, the proportion of PitchBook’s growth that comes from existing clients should increase over time.

topics.topic: PitchBook pricing strategy under Morningstar ownership
topics.stated_position: The pricing strategy "has not changed under Morningstar's ownership," although the company is "now growing PitchBook's data feeds business and exploring more enterprise opportunities than we have in the past," offering seat-based and firm-wide licenses.
topics.quote: The PitchBook pricing strategy has not changed under Morningstar’s ownership. Although, we are now growing PitchBook’s data feeds business and exploring more enterprise opportunities than we have in the past.

topics.stated_position: The PitchBook Plan was renewed for the 2020-2022 period with new annual financial performance targets tied to PitchBook revenue and cash flow; equity awards with aggregate target value of $30.0 million ($7.5M 2020, $7.5M 2021, $15.0M 2022), with upside above target and no payment if threshold conditions are not met — management believes it "is well aligned with the creation of shareholder value."
topics.quote: We renewed the PitchBook Plan for the 2020-2022 period with new financial performance targets for each fiscal year. Targets are tied to revenue and cash flow generation specific to PitchBook performance. Based on the terms of this renewal, equity awards having an aggregate target value equal to $30.0 million will be available for issuance with annual grants of $7.5 million for 2020, $7.5 million in 2021, and $15.0 million in 2022.

topics.stated_position: Management declined to give figures, stating it does not disclose margins of any product line or business area within its portfolio.
topics.quote: We do not disclose margins of any product line or business area within our portfolio .

topics.stated_position: Sustainalytics "operates on a subscription-based pricing model for its ESG research products, which results in recurring revenue," while the Sustainable Finance Solutions unit combines one-time revenue with subscription-based recurring licensing revenue.
topics.quote: Sustainalytics operates on a subscription-based pricing model for its ESG research products, which results in recurring revenue. The Sustainable Finance Solutions unit deploys a model that combines one-time revenue with subscription-based recurring licensing revenue.

topics.topic: Sustainalytics management earnout structure and future ESG disclosure
topics.stated_position: The acquisition was structured with an earnout for Sustainalytics shareholders (including current management) providing cash payments in 2021 and 2022 based on a multiple of 2020 and 2021 fiscal year revenues tracked separately; management said it "will look for ways to provide future disclosure on impact and contribution" as ESG capabilities are integrated.
topics.quote: The acquisition was structured with an earnout for the shareholders of Sustainalytics (which includes current members of management) that will provide cash payments in 2021 and 2022 based on a multiple of 2020 and 2021 fiscal year revenues.

topics.topic: Free cash flow priorities and capital allocation
topics.stated_position: "We continue to take a balanced approach to capital allocation. Our primary emphasis is supporting organic growth; however, we will continue to pursue acquisitions opportunistically." Dividends have had fairly consistent growth rates and payout ratios since 2010; share repurchases are evaluated like any investment and are not "programmatic."
topics.quote: We continue to take a balanced approach to capital allocation. Our primary emphasis is supporting organic growth; however, we will continue to pursue acquisitions opportunistically. Since declaring our first dividend in 2010, we have maintained fairly consistent dividend growth rates and payout ratios. We evaluate share repurchases much like we would any investment, prioritizing available capital against the potential return of the investment, and do not utilize a “programmatic” approach.

topics.topic: Integration of recent acquisitions versus further M&A
topics.stated_position: Management said it is focused on effectively integrating recent acquisitions, but its ongoing strategy includes identifying opportunities that "accelerate our ability to empower investor success," and it is "always monitoring the landscape for interesting opportunities that could add to or strengthen our capabilities."
topics.quote: While we are focused on effectively integrating our recent acquisitions into Morningstar, our ongoing strategy includes identifying opportunities that accelerate our ability to empower investor success while creating value for the business and investors. We currently have many in-flight and planned initiatives to grow the business organically, but we are always monitoring the landscape for interesting opportunities that could add to or strengthen our capabilities.

topics.topic: Characterization of M&A deal activity and multiples
topics.stated_position: "The market is very active in financial services and the prices paid currently reflect strong optimism on the part of acquirers."
topics.quote: The market is very active in financial services and the prices paid currently reflect strong optimism on the part of acquirers.

topics.topic: Morningstar's position on digital assets and cryptocurrency
topics.stated_position: Morningstar "has come to no definitive conclusions on the long-term investment merits of cryptocurrency and its proper role in the portfolio," continues to monitor investor interest, carries over 120 crypto/digital asset exchange feeds, and PitchBook's Emerging Technology Research practice is slated to initiate DeFi research in late Q2 2021.
topics.quote: As a firm, Morningstar has come to no definitive conclusions on the long-term investment merits of cryptocurrency and its proper role in the portfolio or the appropriate treatment from a portfolio analytics perspective. We continue to monitor investor interest in the digital asset space and are evaluating how investors might successfully employ cryptocurrencies in their portfolios.

notable_language.quote: DBRS Morningstar’s overall performance in 2020 highlights the benefits of a global and diverse credit ratings business.
notable_language.why_notable: Frames geographic and asset-class diversification as the core defense of the ratings business — a recurring framing likely to be tested in later years.

notable_language.quote: Competitive rivalry is particularly strong in U.S. corporate credit ratings, where the three large legacy credit ratings agencies concentrate.
notable_language.why_notable: An unusually direct acknowledgment of competitive disadvantage in the largest ratings market, immediately after claiming leadership in Canada.

notable_language.quote: we are leveraging our 45-year experience in assessing complex corporates, our more-granular pricing model, and our local expertise to build our presence in the U.S. corporate middle market sector
notable_language.why_notable: Positions price granularity as a competitive weapon against incumbents — a notable framing of how the company intends to win share.

notable_language.quote: PitchBook uses a combination of cutting-edge technology and a dedicated team of close to 500 data researchers to provide comprehensive, in-depth, and accurate data on the private capital markets.
notable_language.why_notable: Quantifies the human research investment behind the data moat; a headcount claim that can be tracked across years.

notable_language.quote: PitchBook’s profitability continues to increase consistent with our expectations for a high-growth business with a growing installed base of users.
notable_language.why_notable: A qualitative profitability assurance offered in place of any figure, immediately followed by a refusal to disclose segment margins.
